title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje te “Golden Tower Residence”
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 në kompleksin “Golden Tower Residence” , një ndër ndërtimet më cilësore në zonën e Mine Pezës.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8 banim dhe organizohet nga:
• 1 dhome ndenje bashke me ambientin e gatimit.
• 2 dhoma gjumi
• 1 tualet
• 1 ballkon
Apartamenti ka investime extra si :
• Sistemi elektrik
• Instalime hidraulike të reja
• Tavan i varur i përfunduar me kujdes
• Parket i shtruar (jo i firmës ndërtuese)
Orientimi Jug-Lindje i apartamentit mundeson ndriçim natyral gjate gjithe dites.
Lokacioni ku ndodhet ky apartament eshte nje pozicion perfekt pranë qendrës, me akses të shpejtë në Zogun e Zi, Myslym Shyr, Rrugën e Kavajës etj. Afër shërbimeve, shkollave dhe transportit publik — ideale për banim ose investim.
Per me teper informacion apo nje takim ne prone mund te me kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in "Golden Tower Residence"
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the "Golden Tower Residence" complex, one of the best quality buildings in the Mine Peza area. The apartment is located on the 8th residential floor and is organized by: • 1 living room with a kitchen area. • 2 bedrooms • 1 bathroom • 1 balcony The apartment has extra investments such as: • Electrical system • New plumbing • Suspended ceiling carefully finished • Paved parquet (not from the construction company) South-East orientation of the apartment allows natural lighting throughout the day. The location where this apartment is located is a perfect position near the center, with quick access to Zogun e Zi, Myslym Shyr, Rrugë e Kavaja, etc. Close to services, schools and public transport — ideal for living or investment. For more information or an appointment at the property, you can contact me.
